tasks.spec: You are a one-task Ringer probe worker isolating why createDocument lineItems newCostItem elements fail union resolution in JobTread Pave. Twenty staged documents fail with: The value {"newCostItem":{name, unitId, quantity, unitPrice, costCodeId, costTypeId, description}} at createDocument.$.lineItems.0 does not resolve to existingCostGroup/existingCostItem/newCostGroup/newCostItem. Hypotheses: (A) document-context newCostItem rejects costCodeId/costTypeId keys; (B) the specific costTypeId used ('22PazefY5x4j') or costCodeId ('22PbdLkpZX5s') is invalid in this context; (C) some other inner-field constraint (e.g. name length). BOUNDARY: you may create AT MOST 3 temporary documents on ONE pilot job in JobTread org 22PazeRM5FCH, and you MUST delete every document you create before finishing (deleteDocument op) and prove deletion by read-back; no other mutations of any kind; never touch existing entities; deliverables are your only file writes; never log the grant key. CREDS: set -a; source /Users/chussey/.config/cleverwork/master.env; set +a. Build request bodies with python3 json.dumps only. Pave: POST https://api.jobtread.com/pave with {"query": {"$": {"grantKey": "<$JT_SUPABASE_MIRROR_GRANT_KEY>"}, ...}}. Pick the target job: any jt_id from jt_mirror.crosswalk where jt_type='job' (Supabase read: curl -s -X POST https://api.supabase.com/v1/projects/rnhmvcpsvtqjlffpsayu/database/query -H "Authorization: Bearer $SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"query":"select jt_id from jt_mirror.crosswalk where jt_type='\''job'\'' limit 1"}'). PRIOR ROUND (all failed identically — variants WITHOUT unitCost, with/without cost ids, all rejected with the union-resolution error; see ../r3h-lineitem-probe/probe-output.json): the working catalog createCostItem payloads ALL carried unitCost — hypothesis: the newCostItem union variant requires unitCost (and possibly costTypeId) present to resolve. PROBE SEQUENCE (stop at first success): V4 = createDocument {type/name/jobId copied as before, name 'PROBE-DELETE-ME-V4', lineItems: [{"newCostItem": {name: 'Probe Item', unitId: <real unit id>, quantity: 1, unitCost: 8, unitPrice: 10, description: 'probe'}}]} — unitCost added, NO cost ids. V5 = V4 plus costCodeId '22PbdLkpZX5s' and costTypeId '22PazefY5x4j'. V6 = existingCostItem variant: lineItems: [{"existingCostItem": {"costItemId": <jt_id of an executed catalog_items row from jt_mirror.crosswalk jt_type='costItem'>, "quantity": 1}}] (adjust the id key name if the error names the expected key). V7 (only if V4-V6 fail) = V5 with quantity/unitCost/unitPrice as STRINGS ('1','8','10'). Record each full request (grantKey redacted) and full response. CLEANUP: deleteDocument each created id, then re-query it and show null/error proof. DELIVERABLES: /Users/chussey/Documents/a-roofers-open-brain/integrations/bridges/jobtread/mirror/r3h2-lineitem-probe/probe-output.json (array of {variant, request, response, cleanup}) and .../r3h2-lineitem-probe/probe-transcript.md with sections ## Probe Goal, ## Commands Run, ## Observed Behavior, ## Winning Shape (exact JSON element shape that succeeded, or 'none succeeded'), ## Cleanup Proof, ## Verdict. HARD RULES: never claim a variant worked unless the response contained a created document id; if all fail, that is a valid honest outcome — capture every error verbatim.
